about: Each engine page's title, meta description and heading. Titles and headings follow the default for every engine (Amrith: no keyword stuffing); {name} is the catalog name unless an engine gives its own here, and {line} its catalog line. Descriptions come from the go-to-market session, humanizer run, Chess capitalized on purpose. The heading shows "Chess" on screen; the rest of it is read by screen readers.

stockfish.description: Play Chess against Stockfish 19 in your browser, with its full network (a 99 MB download). Levels 1 to 10, untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

stockfish-lite.description: Play Chess against Stockfish 19 in your browser, with a smaller network (a 2 MB download). Levels 1 to 10, untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

fairy-stockfish.description: Play Chess against Fairy-Stockfish, built on Stockfish with a hand-written evaluation. Levels 1 to 10, untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

maia.name: Maia
maia.description: Play Chess against Maia 3, which learned from Lichess games to play like a person at the rating you pick. Untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

arasan.description: Play Chess against Arasan in your browser, Jon Dart's engine at version 26.1. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

clover.description: Play Chess against Clover 9.1 in your browser, the engine by Luca Metehau. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

caissa.description: Play Chess against Caissa 2.0 in your browser, Michał Witanowski's engine. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

plentychess.description: Play Chess against PlentyChess 8 in your browser, the engine by Yoshie2000. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

halogen.description: Play Chess against Halogen 16 in your browser, Kieren Pearson's engine. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

koivisto.description: Play Chess against Koivisto 9 in your browser, by Kim Kåhre and Finn Eggers. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.

ethereal.description: Play Chess against Ethereal 14, Andrew Grant's engine, in its classical build. Pick a level from 1 to 10 and play untimed or on a clock. Free, with no account.
